attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell for roofs and back walls (CC BY 4.0): the light-brown brick canal front with round-arched windows under stone arch rings, brick lesenes and corbel brackets, a brick panel band, the white Perdu sign board over the entrance and three roof dormers.
